push.title: W 6-1 vs Cotteville Bums | You: 10.0 (Perfect Game #6)
push.body:
Perfect Game #6, buddskees. A 10.0 against Cotteville Bums. If football had a dictionary, your picture would be next to 'flawless'.

THE GOOD
+ A perfect 10.0, your 6th Perfect Game for us. That's growth you can count.
+ 2 of 2 shots on target. Patient in the box, precise with the boot.
+ 3 key passes (up from your usual 0). You made your teammates look like heroes. That's real leadership.
+ Man of the Match, your 18th for us. Frame it, then hang it where your mama can see it.
+ Your vision plus PhogsToffees's finishing equals a very happy coach.

THE BAD
- Tackles attempted 0, down from your usual 3. That's on the to-do list now.
- Lowest shots on the team: 2 (best was PhogsToffees's 5). Real talk: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run.
- Pass accuracy: 84%. Climb to 88%+ and you're top quarter.

Backyard drill: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into.

buddskees, something I want you to sleep on: Stay humble, hustle hard, hydrate harder.

That's how legends start. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 6-1 vs Cotteville Bums | You: 9.6 (3rd best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, you just put up a 9.6. My heart's doing a little two-step right now.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Cotteville Bums's goal. You kept the pressure on like a lid on a pot.
+ 2 key passes. That's the kind of creativity that keeps opposing coaches up at night.
+ buddskees owes you a milkshake for those passes.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. Put that in the team scrapbook.
+ Your 3rd best match performance of the season, at 9.6. Every season needs a few of these.

THE BAD
- 3 of 5 shots on target. Try it this way: Shoot from central, inside the box. Tight angles and long range are where shots go wide.
- Lowest assists on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 2). That's the part of the tape we'll rewind.
- Lowest passes attempted on the team: 21 (best was buddskees's 31). Easy win: Drop between the lines to link play, then spin in behind once it goes wide.
- Most missed tackles on the team: 3 (best was buddskees's 0). We need more from you there, and I know you've got it.

Muscle memory: The best shots come from the middle of the box. Work it there before you pull the trigger.

Before you go, PhogsToffees: Biscuits fix most things. Practice fixes the rest.

That's the player I knew you were. - Coach Lasso

push.body:
BellyTb1, a 9.6 against Cotteville Bums. I'm gonna need a minute. Somebody hand me a tissue and a clipboard.

THE GOOD
+ 5 shots at Cotteville Bums's goal. You kept testing them until something cracked.
+ 1 key pass. Every key pass is a love letter to a teammate.
+ You and buddskees had more chemistry than a high school lab.
+ This result took us into promotion matches in Division 3. That's what happens when we pull the same rope.
+ 9.6, your 3rd best match performance of the season. Bottle it.

THE BAD
- 71% passing (17 of 24, down from your usual 79%). Between you and me: Before the killer ball, check: is my runner onside, moving, and unmarked? Two out of three isn't enough. Keep it simple, keep it sweet.
- Lowest key passes on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 3). Let's sharpen this: Look forward first. Check the striker's run and the gap between the lines before the sideways pass.
- 1 tackle won shaved 0.1 off. Clean that up and you're flying.
- Shots on target: 80%. Mid-pack today, 90%+ tomorrow.

Training-ground special: If nothing's on, keep it: shield, turn back, let the shape reset. Patience is a pass too.

Between you and me, BellyTb1: Nobody remembers the miss. Everybody remembers the response.

What a joy. What a game. - Coach Lasso
